personality_one_liner: Command-center indoor signage player optimized for Android TV, remote control D-pad navigation, and robust offline loop playback.

spacing.rule: Generous touch and remote focus padding with compact information density for TV screens.

do's: Use translucent glass overlays for settings panel and playback overlay on Android TV
Ensure high contrast text over blurred or tinted dark surfaces
dont's: Never blur active full-screen video playback canvas
Avoid low contrast text on glass surfaces

screens.name: PlayerScreen
screens.purpose: Fullscreen continuous loop player for MP4 videos and timed images (JPG/PNG) sorted alphabetically from Google Drive tiny.cc playlist.

states.loading: Connecting to tiny.cc link and caching playlist media files locally...
states.empty: No media files found in Google Drive folder. Add MP4 or JPG files and update now.
states.error: Failed to sync with Google Drive. Playing last valid offline cache.

screens.layout: Fullscreen media canvas with auto-hiding remote-control focus overlay, showing active playlist index, sync status badge, and menu shortcut button.

screens.name: SettingsScreen
screens.purpose: Configuration dashboard for device name, tiny.cc playlist link, image display duration, rotation, autostart, and manual sync triggers.

states.empty: Configure your Google Drive tiny.cc link to initialize indoor playlist.
states.error: Invalid URL or network timeout. Check connection and retry.

screens.layout: Single column form with D-pad focusable fields, toggle switches for autostart, precise rotation selectors (0°, 90°, -90°, 180°), and primary sticky action buttons.

signage_hero.alt: Digital signage display screen abstract mockup

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React Native / Expo indoor digital signage media player app fully in Portuguese, optimized for Android TV, TV boxes, tablets, and phones. Implement tiny.cc Google Drive folder playlist parser, 60s background sync with offline persistent storage (FileSystem/AsyncStorage), media rotation (0°, 90°, -90°, 180°), configurable image duration (default 10s), autostart boot receiver, D-pad remote control support, and full settings configuration UI.
